label: PV
description: Optional per-PV-system DC power as pv.{pv_system_id}.sens_pv_production_active on pv_systems[].ehal_bindings. Plant AC PV is derived from Σ grid-tied inv.*.sens_inv_power_pv · η_inv (not a plant telemetry field).

ehal_fields.notes: Optional per-PV-system DC power in W (≥ 0) as pv.{id}.sens_pv_production_active. Not required when inv.{id}.sens_inv_power_pv is mapped for the attached inverter.

unit_sign_notes: See docs/referenz/ehal.md § Units and sign convention / Multi-inverter live PV attribution.
